startUrl.title: Website
startUrl.description: The site to audit. A bare domain is enough (example.com) and https:// is assumed. You can also give a full URL to start from a specific page.

maxPages.title: Max pages to audit
maxPages.description: How many pages of the site are opened and checked. Each page is one charged event.

maxDepth.title: Max crawl depth
maxDepth.description: How many clicks away from the start page the crawler goes. 0 audits only the start page.

requestDelaySeconds.title: Delay between requests
requestDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait between two requests to the same host. Keep it at 1 or more to stay polite. If the site's robots.txt asks for a longer Crawl-delay, the longer value is used.

requestTimeoutSeconds.title: Request timeout
requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for a response before the page is reported as a timeout.
